title: Operations Manager - NAPS/NATS
description:
**Job Description – Operations Manager**

**Experience:** 5–8 Years  
**Industry:** Skill Development \| Apprenticeship \| Workforce Management  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Chakan Pune \- PAN India Travel Required

Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Operations Manager** to manage the end\-to\-end operations of **skill development, apprenticeship, and work\-integrated learning programs**.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience with **NAPS, NATS, WILP**, program implementation, compliance, stakeholder management, and team leadership. The candidate should be comfortable managing operations across multiple locations and travelling PAN India as required.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end\-to\-end program operations, including **mobilization, onboarding, training, apprenticeship, assessment, placement, and completion**.
* Manage **NAPS, NATS, and WILP** processes, documentation, compliance, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate effectively with **employers, training partners, educational institutions, candidates, and government stakeholders**.
* Monitor key operational metrics including **enrollment, joining, attendance, retention, completion, placement, and overall program KPIs**.
* Manage MIS, dashboards, reports, documentation, and audit requirements.
* Lead, manage, and mentor operations teams across multiple programs and locations.
* Handle operational escalations and ensure timely and effective resolution.
* Develop and implement **SOPs, processes, and operational frameworks** to improve efficiency and quality.
* Support new business and project launches, including:
* Setting up operational processes and systems.
* Hiring and deploying operational teams.
* Coordinating project implementation.
* Ensuring smooth and timely project launch.
* Travel **PAN India** as required for operational escalations, new project/business setup, team deployment, client meetings, and program implementation.
* Work closely with senior management to ensure successful execution of programs and achievement of operational targets.

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Strong working knowledge of **NAPS, NATS, and WILP**.
* Good understanding of the **skill development and apprenticeship ecosystem**.
* Strong experience in operations and team management.
* Excellent employer, client, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in **MS Excel, MIS, reporting, and data analysis**.
* Strong understanding of compliance and documentation processes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and execution capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, teams, and locations simultaneously.
* **Willingness to travel PAN India as required.**

Qualification \& Experience

* Graduate degree required; **MBA/PGDM preferred**.
* **5–8 years of relevant experience** in Skill Development, Apprenticeship, Training, HR, Workforce Management, or Operations.
* Candidates with hands\-on experience managing **NAPS/NATS/WILP programs** will be preferred.
* Prior experience in multi\-location operations and team leadership will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a **hands\-on operations leader** who can build processes, manage teams, coordinate with multiple stakeholders, resolve operational challenges, and ensure successful delivery of skill development and apprenticeship programs from **project launch through completion**.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹70,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Manager-Operations
description:
“130 years of trust, time to shape what's next. Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers \- built on over a century of stability, expertise, and financial strength. Allianz Services is where that legacy meets the future. 8,200\+ people. Eight countries. Three continents. We deliver specialized services to clients within Allianz Group, powered by AI, advanced analytics, and a mindset that refuses to stand still. From core insurance operations to engineering and consulting services, we reimagine how insurance works. What truly sets us apart are our people and the trusted partnerships we build, anchored in our values of expertise, integrity, and empowerment. We don't support the business. We shape it.”
  
**Job Description :** Manager Operations \-US Life Insurance
  
**Location:** Pune, India
  
**Work Model:** Work from Office
  
**Shift:** US Night Shift
  
**Function:** Insurance Operations / Client Delivery
  
  

**Role Overview :**  

We are seeking a highly experienced and dynamic Manager Insurance Operations to lead end\-to\-end operations for a strategic insurance client. This is a high\-impact leadership role requiring a strong combination of Insurance domain expertise ( Life, Retail, Commercial insurance ), operational leadership, client management, project/program management, transition management, automation, business development support and executive communication. The successful candidate will be responsible not only for ensuring operational excellence and meeting agreed service levels, but also for identifying opportunities to transform the operation, improve customer experience, drive automation, support new business pursuits and lead strategic initiatives for the client. The individual should be equally comfortable running the business, improving the business and engaging confidently with senior client stakeholders and CXO\-level audiences.
  
  

**Required Qualifications ExperienceEssential:**  

10\+ years of overall experience, with significant experience in Insurance operations ( Life / Retail / Commercial ). Strong experience managing US Insurance / Life Annuity operations / Retail / Commercial. Demonstrated experience managing end\-to\-end operations across the Life / Retail / Commercial Insurance value chain. Strong understanding of US Insurance products, processes and policy lifecycle. Proven experience managing large teams and multiple operational processes. Demonstrated experience in client\-facing roles with senior US stakeholders. Proven experience in managing operational SLAs, KPIs, quality and productivity. Demonstrated experience in new client transitions / migrations. Demonstrated experience in building teams from scratch and scaling them. Demonstrated experience in driving automation and process transformation with measurable outcomes. Strong project management / program management experience. Proven experience creating new business proposals, RFP responses and client presentations. Excellent PowerPoint presentation and storytelling skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities. Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity and make sound business decisions. Willingness to work in a US night shift environment. Willingness to work 100% from office.
  
  

**Qualifications:**  

Bachelors degree in Business, Insurance, Finance, Operations, Engineering or a related discipline. Master’s degree / MBA preferred.
  
State Insurance Adjuster / Claims Adjuster certification or relevant US state insurance licensing .
  
LOMA / FLMI / ALMI or equivalent Life Insurance certification preferred.
  
Lean Six Sigma certification preferred. PMP / PRINCE2 / Agile certification preferred. Experience working with Life Insurance policy administration platforms such as Guidewire, Majesco, Sapiens, Vitech, FAST, Oracle/legacy PAS platforms or similar is desirable. Exposure to RPA, AI/GenAI, workflow automation, process mining and analytics tools is preferred. Experience working with US clients and understanding US insurance operating models is strongly preferred.
  
105457 \| Operations \| Management \| Non\-Executive \| Allianz Services \| Full\-Time \| Permanent
  
Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.
  
  

**At Allianz, we stand for unity:** we believe that a united world is a more prospous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.
  
  

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.
  
  

Great to have you on board.Let's care for tomorrow.

title: Manager - Customer Service Operations
description:
**Role:** Cisco Catalyst SD‑WAN L3 Engineer / SME **Location:** Pune **Experience:** 7–10\+ years (3–5 years Catalyst SD‑WAN mandatory)


**Job Summary**



Hiring an experienced **Cisco Catalyst SD‑WAN L3 Engineer** with strong hands‑on expertise in **vManage, SD‑WAN Controllers, Catalyst SD‑WAN Edge**, overlay/underlay design, OMP, centralized/data policies, segmentation, and advanced routing. The role involves complex SD‑WAN deployments, L3 escalations, WAN migrations, and performance optimization for enterprise networks.


**Key Responsibilities**



✔️ Deploy, configure \& troubleshoot **Cisco Catalyst SD‑WAN** (vManage, Controllers, Catalyst SD‑WAN Edge) ✔️ Lead **L3 escalation handling**, fabric outages, tunnel issues, OMP \& policy failures ✔️ Design hybrid WAN (MPLS \+ Internet \+ LTE) and optimize routing ✔️ Migrate legacy MPLS/VPN networks to Catalyst SD‑WAN ✔️ Tune App‑Aware routing, QoS, segmentation \& centralized/localized policies ✔️ Perform RCA, upgrades, patches \& lifecycle management ✔️ Prepare HLD/LLD, SOPs, runbooks \& follow ITIL processes


**Required Skills**



 Hands‑on expertise in Cisco Catalyst SD‑WAN architecture \& components Strong in OMP, control/data policies, routing \& segmentation Protocols: BGP, OSPF, VRF, IPSec Tools: SolarWinds, Zabbix, PRTG Basic firewall knowledge (Fortinet / Palo Alto / ASA / Checkpoint) Strong troubleshooting using PCAP, logs, control connections


**Preferred Certifications**



 Cisco SD‑WAN Specialist (Catalyst SD‑WAN) CCNP Enterprise / Security CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure / Security (added advantage) ITIL Foundation

* sdwan
* routing
* cisco
* cisco catalyst sdwan
* vmanage
* sdwan controllers
* catalyst sdwan edge
* bgp
* ospf

title: AM Customer Care
description:
### **About Us**


At Kohler, our mission is to help people live gracious, healthy, and sustainable lives. We believe that empowering our associates is essential to making this vision a reality. That’s why we invest in personal and professional growth, encourage collaboration across teams and functions, and offer a comprehensive wellness package that supports the well\-being of every team member.


Kohler is an equal opportunity employer. Along with competitive compensation and benefits, we offer something more enduring—a legacy built on bold innovation, creative excellence, and a deep commitment to our people and communities. Learn more about our culture and career opportunities at www.kohler.co.in/careers.


Our approach to hiring reflects our commitment to **Global Inclusion**. We recruit, hire, and promote qualified individuals in all roles without regard to race, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, or disability. If you are an individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process, please let your recruiter know so we can support you appropriately.


  
Job Description:
Kohler Co.'s mission is to contribute to a higher level of gracious living for those who are touched by our products and services.


Beyond the competitive benefits and compensation, Kohler proudly offers a rich culture, steeped in creativity and commitment to our associates and communities. We invite you to learn more about our culture and company at www.kohlercompany.com


It is Kohler’s policy to recruit, hire, and promote qualified personnel in all job classifications without regard to race, creed, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Kohler Co. is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.


**Kohler India is certified as a Great Place to Work Organization. This certification is an endorsement of the culture and values we live by \- every day.**

  

**Position Description**


**Position Title**

  

AM – Customer Care

  

  

**Department**

  

Customer Services

  

  

**Division**

  

Kohler India Technical Center, Pune

  

  

**Grade**

  

AM

  

  

**Reporting to**

Manager – Customer Care

  

  

**About the position:**

We (Kohler India Technical Center) are a captive global center providing technical and nontechnical support for all the businesses and product lines for Kohler India (Kitchen and Bath).


As a Customer Care Assistant Manager at Kohler, you will be responsible for managing the daily operations of our Customer Care department. You will oversee a team of customer care associates, ensuring that they provide excellent service to our end consumers. In this role, you will be responsible for setting goals and metrics, monitoring performance, and implementing strategies to improve customer experience. You will also work closely with other departments to ensure smooth operations and effective communication.


**Role and Responsibility:**


**Be a Brand Ambassador for our customers by building relationships and creating loyalty**. Provide world\-class first level inbound phone/chat/email support for customers by troubleshooting, investigating, and resolving customers' inquiries about Kohler India products with the goal of resolving each issue on the first contact. You will be expected to provide empathetic, courteous, quality customer service in an accurate and timely manner in accordance with Kohler protocols while maintaining a positive, problem\-solving approach.

  

* Manage and oversee the daily operations of the Customer Care department.
* Hire, train, and supervise a team of customer service associates.
* Set performance goals and metrics for the team and monitor progress.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve customer experience.
* Maintain and improve customer service level agreements and procedures.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and provide regular reports to senior management.
* Collaborate with other departments, such as sales, marketing, and operations, to ensure smooth operations and effective communication.
* Develop and maintain relationships with key customers.
* Provide coaching and feedback to team members to improve their performance and development.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and efficiencies.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures, as well as applicable regulations and laws.

**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree mandatory – master’s degree preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience in customer service or related field, with at least 5 years in a people management role.
* Strong leadership, Problem solving and People management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and develop strategies.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and customer service software.
* Experience working in the manufacturing industry is preferred.
  

This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as assigned by the supervisor.


**Working Conditions:**


This is a full\-time role based in our customer service Pune office. The includes evenings and weekends working to meet customer demands, as we operate 24/7\. You'll work six days a week with rotating shifts and weekly offs. Occasional travel for business may also be required.


**Organizational Relationships:**

* Reports to Manager – Customer Care,
* Regular interactions with business stakeholders from different Kohler business verticals at ITC
* Frequent interaction with internal stakeholders including senior leadership team.
Mandatory Skills:
Team Management, Escalation Management, People Leadership, Inbound Voice Process, Data Analytics, Reports and Dashboards


Location:
Magarpatta, Hadapsar, Pune, Maharashtra, India


Experience:
12 to 15 years
